description: Get one event by slug. One published event with its upcoming dates and its organizer's pictures (`images`, the first is the cover). `owned` says whether an organizer manages it, and `managedBy` names that organizer (their public page's slug, name and picture) when their profile is public. A former slug (the event was renamed when its year or town changed) answers the same event, under its current `slug`. A cancelled event whose dates aren't over yet also answers, with `cancelled` true and no upcoming dates; `scheduleChange` says when a published event is postponed, rescheduled (with `previousStartDate`) or moved online.
name: get_event
title: Get one event by slug
